description: A cold northern sea seen from above: white pack ice and floes on the left, open teal ocean on the right. Repaint so the ice thins gradually into the sea — large floes breaking into smaller scattered ones, then meltwater and open teal water — with an irregular ragged ice edge that follows the water, not a straight line. Remove any rectangular block of ice or straight boundary between ice and ocean. Keep the same white and teal palette and pixel-art style.
